data.body:
Closing as not-a-defect. The operator confirms this was a planned MAINTENANCE WINDOW on the review bot, since resolved — not fallout from the eb6e Bedrock cutover as this ticket inferred.

The inference was wrong in an instructive way and is worth leaving on the record: the 00:28 healthy / 00:45 403 window really did bracket the cutover going live, and the IAM reading (no deny anywhere in the instance role, CI's separate Bedrock role unaffected) really did point at an account-level guardrail. Both observations were accurate; the causal story built on them was not. A maintenance window produces the same signature as a permissions regression, and nothing I could read from outside distinguished them — the operator's knowledge of the schedule was the missing evidence.

No infrastructure was touched: I stopped at read-only IAM inspection and escalated rather than acting on production.
